verdict.rationale: Bitwarden's first-party authenticator import/export docs list direct imports from other authenticator apps: Google Authenticator via its QR code, LastPass Authenticator via JSON export, and 2FAS via its .2fas backup file. These are export-based bulk migrations that avoid re-enrolling each account by hand, and the imported codes can then sync with Password Manager. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that bulk imports work reliably, evidence of support for other common authenticators beyond these three, and in-depth detail on import limits or edge cases.
